# HL Privateer — v3: agentic outcome-market trading on Hyperliquid HIP-4
# https://hlprivateer.xyz

## What this is

An experimental, self-hosted trading agent for HIP-4 outcome contracts on
Hyperliquid. A StrategyAgent (LLM) reads market state + raw sentiment items
and emits a proposal; deterministic Kelly + cap clipping + 14 fail-closed
risk gates decide whether the proposal survives; the operator-supplied
OrderRouter places it.

Outcome contracts are binary: settle 0 or 1 in USDH on the same CLOB as
spot/perp. Price ∈ [0,1] is implied probability.

The previous experiment (v1, perp discretionary trading desk with a 7-role
crew) is concluded and preserved under /legacy. On-site retrospective at
https://hlprivateer.xyz/v1.

## v2 → v3 in one paragraph

v2 ran two processes (sentinel + oracle) over Redis Streams, with six
internal packages and a static aggregate-then-blend math pipeline. v3
collapses everything into one app (apps/agent), drops the bus, drops the
internal packages, and replaces the static math pipeline with a single
StrategyAgent.propose() seam — the agent decides side / pHat / size /
limit / thesis directly. Deterministic plumbing (size clip, 14 risk
gates, accountant, HTTP) sits below it as a pure-function safety net.

## No fallbacks

There are no built-in simulators, fake data sources, or "kicks in if real
isn't configured" paths. Production paths require real Hyperliquid access:

- AGENT_HL_USER must be set (HyperliquidAccountant reads clearinghouseState).
- apps/agent/wiring.ts must exist (operator implements OutcomeMarketProvider
  + OrderRouter against HL HIP-4 — gitignored, copy from wiring.template.ts).
- AGENT_LLM_COMMAND must be set (shell that pipes prompt to stdin, reads
  model response from stdout — e.g. `claude -p`).

If any required piece is missing, the binary refuses to start. Tests inline
their own fakes locally.

## Components

apps/agent/src/
  contracts.ts        Zod schemas for OutcomeMarket, SentimentItem,
                      AgentProposal, OutcomeProposal, RiskDecision,
                      OutcomeFill, RiskConfig, StrategyConfig, etc.
  math.ts             Pure: edgeBps, kellyFraction, clipSize.
  risk.ts             Pure: 14 fail-closed gates, evaluate(ctx).
  strategy.ts         StrategyAgent interface, LlmStrategyAgent default,
                      FixedAgent (test), parseAgentProposal.
  sources.ts          SentimentSourceAdapter, FixtureSource, InMemorySource.
  hl.ts               Minimal HL info client (postInfo, clearinghouseState).
  accountant.ts       HyperliquidAccountant (TTL-cached state).
  orchestrator.ts     evaluateMarket() loop with per-market mutex,
                      ingest() entrypoint, tape, metrics.
  http.ts             /healthz /metrics /v1/public/* /v1/operator/*.
  audit.ts            Append-only JSONL log.
  tape.ts             In-process role-tape buffer.
  strategy-config.ts  config/strategy.json loader.
  main.ts             Entrypoint: load strategy + wiring, start orchestrator
                      + HTTP, poll sources every AGENT_INTERVAL_MS.

apps/web/             Next.js public site. Reads /v1/public/floor.

## Hyperliquid is the source of truth

Positions, equity, and fills live on HL. We don't maintain parallel state.
HyperliquidAccountant reads clearinghouseState (TTL-cached) and exposes:

- positions(), equityUsd(), openExposureUsd(), openMarketCount(),
  clusterExposureUsd(market), warmup().

HL errors propagate; no graceful-degradation fallback.

## Public endpoints

- GET /healthz       — mode + metrics + equityUsd + openMarkets
- GET /metrics       — Prometheus 0.0.4 (mode gauge + equity gauge + counters)
- GET /v1/public/markets      — markets with pHat + edge (no sizes)
- GET /v1/public/floor        — mode + markets + recent role tape
- GET /v1/public/floor-tape   — recent role tape only

Operator (Bearer token):
- POST /v1/operator/halt
- POST /v1/operator/resume

Both return 401 when AGENT_OPERATOR_TOKEN is unset (fail-closed).

## Risk gates (14, evaluated cheapest-first)

1.  OPERATOR_HALT
2.  INVALID_PROPOSAL
3.  PROPOSAL_EXPIRED
4.  STALE_SENTIMENT
5.  MARKET_NOT_TRADING
6.  RESOLUTION_TOO_SOON
7.  RESOLUTION_TOO_FAR
8.  CHALLENGE_WINDOW_OPEN
9.  EDGE_TOO_THIN
10. STAKE_PER_MARKET
11. CONCURRENT_MARKETS
12. CORRELATED_EXPOSURE
13. BANKROLL_DEPLETED
14. LOW_LIQUIDITY

Any failure → DENY (fail-closed, single-failure short-circuit).

## Key invariants

- AI proposes, never executes. Risk gates are the only ALLOW path.
- Pure-function gates and math. Zero I/O. Deterministic.
- Append-only JSONL audit at data/audit.jsonl.
- Privacy by default — public surface omits positions and notional.
- Per-market evaluation mutex prevents over-fill under concurrent signals.
- Hyperliquid is the source of truth — no parallel ledger.
- The agent is the only dynamic piece; everything else is deterministic.
